newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,988 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,988 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 3,988 contracts compared with 1,330 overnight Thursday.
There were 229 wheat, 1,845 corn, 1,759 soybean, 32 soymeal, 90 soyoil, one oat, 18 corn calls, 13 soybean cals and one soybean put traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was four to five cents lower, corn was eight to nine cents lower and soybeans were 16 to 20 cents lower.
